bart.instruct: Gravelly, slow, menacing old gunslinger. Low voice, very few words, every word a threat.

tex.instruct: Young cowboy trying hard to sound tough, a little defensive and proud.

pruitt.instruct: Dry, polite, deadpan undertaker. Unhurried, precise and quietly businesslike, as if nothing is unusual.

pianist.instruct: A sharp, sudden yelp of pain.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.text: Rule's simple. When the piano stops, we draw.

lines.speaker: pruitt
lines.text: One moment, gentlemen. For the newspaper.

lines.speaker: bart
lines.text: So. Do we start the piano again?

lines.speaker: tex
lines.text: His fingers are still in the lid.
